# GMEOW Notes & Annotation Module

The GMEOW Notes & Annotation Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/notes>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/notes`  

**Type:** `owl:Ontology`  

First-class annotation and personal-knowledge-management layer — notes, highlights, bookmarks, comments, and the bidirectional backlink graph (the RDF gap GMEOW fills). Reuses, never duplicates: EvidenceSpan/Selector for anchored targets (#55), aboutness/Tagging for topics (#27), accordingTo for standpoint (#43), displayable for suppression (P10). Grounded in gUFO; aligned to W3C Web Annotation, schema.org, ActivityStreams, and SIOC by reference (P5).

**Defined by:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/notes>
